histogram.name: Browser.Actuator.SessionRegistry.ExistingSessionsCount
histogram.summary: Records the number of active transport sessions in TransportSessionRegistryImpl when a request is made for a session ID that is not currently in the registry.

histogram.name: Browser.Actuator.SessionRegistry.SessionLimitReached
histogram.summary: Records whether a request to create a transport session in TransportSessionRegistryImpl was rejected because the maximum concurrent active transport sessions limit was reached. Recorded only when a request is made for a session ID that is not currently in the registry (false = session created, true = limit reached).

histogram.name: Browser.Actuator.Upstream.HttpStatus
histogram.summary: Records the HTTP response status codes returned by the upstream endpoint fetcher for POST upload requests. Recorded when an HTTP response is received from the server.

histogram.name: Browser.Actuator.Upstream.PayloadSize.{PayloadType}
histogram.summary: Records the serialized payload size in bytes of outgoing messages of the specified {PayloadType}. Recorded immediately before the message is serialized and dispatched via HTTP POST to the upstream endpoint.

histogram.name: Browser.Actuator.Upstream.UploadLatency.{PayloadType}
histogram.summary: Records round-trip latency (from SendUpstreamMessage invocation to network POST response callback) for messages of the specified {PayloadType}. Recorded when the upstream network response is received (or fails). Not recorded for aborted or cancelled requests.
